items.title: Students express concerns at first BYU town hall meeting
items.summary: The BYU Daily Universe reports that BYU's Office of Civic Engagement hosted a town hall where two Provo City Council members took questions from about 105 attendees, mostly students. The first topic was parking at the Park Plaza apartment project.

items.title: Mormon Senior Missions: Working for Free Isn't Enough? Mormon News 11.16.26
items.summary: A Generally Unquotable YouTube video says some senior missionaries are expected to cover thousands of dollars in monthly living expenses while volunteering, and asks how that squares with the church's wealth.

items.title: When Your Daughter Leaves the Mormon Church – Kari & Kimberly Bates | Ep. 2231
items.summary: On Mormon Stories, Kari and Kimberly Bates discuss choosing their relationship with their child over the expectations of their faith after their daughter left the Mormon church.

items.title: Why Mormon Voters Almost Walked Away From Trump
items.summary: Historian Benjamin Park revisits Donald Trump's 2016 "Mormon problem" in a YouTube video, asking how one of America's reddest states became a three-way race.
